sloka: सर्वैः क्रतुशतैरिष्टं सर्वे मायाविदस्तथा ।सर्वे सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः सर्वे शत्रुभयङ्कराः ।। ७.६.३७ ॥
transliteration: sarvaiḥ kratuśatairiṣṭaṁ sarve māyāvidastathā ।sarve sarvāstrakuśalāḥ sarve śatrubhayaṅkarāḥ ।। 7.6.37 ॥

translations.english: All these Asuras and Danavas, though endowed with great strength and power, are never heard to have remained undefeated once they entered battle.
